title: 2026 Season Power Rankings
subtitle: Post–Week 2 board — undefeated four, kitty to the Host, Saquon on the move. Whole picture, not just points for.
method: W/L + win quality + roster ceiling + FAAB + pedigree + sit/start + trades; PF is evidence, not the ranking.

rankings.blurb: Juice: 2-0 the hard way — Gesicki robbed Bill in Week 1, then JSN’s 54 and Stafford/DeVonta/Cooper stacked a 279 that edged Hyper’s 272 by seven. Undefeated, league-top undefeated PF (534), and the flex/TE discipline that already owned one sit/start scandal. Junk: Micah still rehabbing, FAAB at $83, and Newman just remembered how WR1s work. Stay boring on the board; the smirk only lasts if the lineup stays adult.

Juice: Back-to-back statement Ws — Watt/Henry buried Newman, then Devin Lloyd’s 66 and Mahomes’ 40 closed 274.5 on Bill. 2-0, 528.5 PF, veteran violence still prints, and the IDP nuclear option just went league-headline. Junk: Kamara/Jacobs IR cloud hasn’t cleared; FAAB $84; Week 3 is a 2-0 heavyweight vs Divers. Pedigree got you here — depth and health keep you.

Juice: Still 2-0 with the best points-against in the room (335) and Josh Allen still cheating (47 again). You didn’t need another 315; you needed a win over a flatlining Dongers card and you took it. Junk: 188.5 is a hangover after the format war crime, Goedert’s 1.5 was a trade punchline, and FAAB is already down to $59. Prove Week 1 was a floor — living off the highlight reel ends the second Allen has a human week.

Juice: Quietly perfect at 2-0. Beat the dual-era champ, then collected Substation 215–171 with Kelce’s 39 and IDP adults while JJ/Deebo ghosted. Full $115 FAAB wallet — richest unspent stack in the league — and the magazine-cover core still hasn’t needed Plan B. Junk: Depth remains thin; 473.5 PF is fine-not-filthy for undefeated; Goats bring Lloyd energy next. Stars-or-bust only works while the stars remember the assignment.

Juice: Host renaissance. 322.5 kitty — Goff 43 / CeeDee 41 / Will Anderson 39 — and the punchline: Waddle scored 27 after last week’s flex single. League-leading 539 PF, $111 FAAB, McBride/Kincaid TE bullying. Week 1 was the self-inflicted wound; Week 2 was the receipt. Junk: Still 1-1, and Substation’s garage-sale roster is desperate enough to be dangerous. Don’t confuse a nuclear Tuesday with a free pass to get cute again.

Juice: 272 is a win most Tuesdays — Amon-Ra 41, Walker 32, Bolton/Cashman 30–30 — and 531.5 PF says the rookie franchise is real. Dart’s still in the building; the Monday heist wasn’t a fluke ceiling. Junk: Herbert’s 9 turned a grown-up card into a seven-point L against Luke, and prove-it mode just got harder. Survive Slumlords’ new Cook toy next or the legitimacy talk stalls at .500.

Juice: Sleepwalking ended. Adams went from a Week 1 five-spot to 47, JT punched 32, and Doubtpfizer left at 213. Back to .500 with a WR orchard that finally remembered the job and $110 FAAB still loaded. Junk: Brown/Higgins/etc. still need to show up together; Saltese is next and doesn’t gift empty WR weeks. One bounce-back doesn’t make you contenders — two in a row might.

Juice: 0-2 with 492.5 PF is the cruelest flex in the room — 241 and 251.5 both lose to boards that printed more. Warner/Lake/IDP choir still filthy (Evan Williams 34, Lake 28, the Williams brothers 27–27). Ceiling that sat preseason #1 didn’t vanish; the matchups just hated you. Junk: TLaw’s ceremonial 4; two sit/start-adjacent scars (Pitts flex W1, then another empty-handed 250). Climb starts by cashing a W against Dongers’ floor, not by moral victories.

Juice: CMC / Nico / Rice / Dak spine is still championship DNA, Dak’s 37 and Dean’s 32 were real punches, and $109 FAAB can buy a fix. Dual-era résumé doesn’t expire because Divers and Newman looked awake. Junk: 0-2 is 0-2 — 237 then 213 is ugly-adjacent for this franchise, and Ultron just imported Saquon. Don’t panic-trade the spine; do panic about another empty week while Aga’s new toys debut.

Juice: First W of 2026 was an IDP heist (Hooker 30, defense 122) while Chase/Cook finally showed up, then Aga went shopping — Saquon + Tank in from Sub for London/Winston/$20, after flipping Cook/Godwin/Anzalone/$15 for London/Pickens/Campbell from Slumlords. Roster ceiling just got loud. Junk: Offense still posted 78.5 in the win (Caleb 6, Loveland 1.5, QJ 1); FAAB down to $76 after the spree; 380.5 PF is bottom-tier. New toys don’t auto-start themselves — and Doubtpfizer’s spine is waiting.

Juice: W1 was the clean plan — Puka / Kyren / Roquan / Hutch showing up for 246. $104 FAAB and the core names didn’t evaporate overnight. Junk: Week 2 was a funeral at 182 — Atwell’s 2 as a skill starter while Davis-Gaither’s 32 carried bricks, and Ultron’s garage-sale defense outscored your identity. Stay boring was the W1 note; you got cute/thin and paid. TTAB’s Allen tax is next — no more experimental WR slots.

Juice: Still 1-1 after banking the Ultron garage-sale W, then selling Saquon + Tank for London / Winston / $20 — FAAB up to $97 and the trade block finally cleared Barkley/Bigsby (20 still listed). You’re dealing, not drifting. Junk: 364 PF is the league cellar; 171 behind Divers with Pierce 2 / Monty 4; Nix-adjacent QB chaos still lurks. Pocket’s 322 hangover is next — London has to button or the garage sale becomes a going-out-of-business sign.

Juice: 252 against Pocket’s 322.5 is a quality L with a pulse — Schultz 41 / Budda 38 showed up — and the Ultron deal landed James Cook + Godwin + Anzalone + $15 (FAAB $113). Survivor Week 1 alumni just bought a real RB. Junk: Still 0-2; London/Pickens shipped out after they ghosted; Maye’s 6; Hyper’s 531.5 PF machine is next. Climb starts when the new Cook touches and the skill guys stop totaling a TE game.

Juice: Bijan and Olave can still print (they did for 24 and 22 in the wreckage); Hamilton’s 32 was real; $93 FAAB isn’t dead. The skill core didn’t resign. Junk: 158.5 league floor after the Monday erasure — Survivor eviction, 0-2, nothing cute about it. Goedert’s 1.5 on the other sideline still beat your vibe. Eddies are desperate for a first W and bring IDP violence. Stop the bleeding or own the basement.
